book.title: Tropic of Capricorn
book.description: Banned in America for almost 30 years because of its explicit sexual content, this companion volume to Miller's Tropic of Cancer chronicles his life in 1920s New York City. Famous for its frank portrayal of life in Brooklyn's ethnic neighborhoods & Miller's outrageous sexual exploits, Tropic of Capricorn is now considered a cornerstone of modern literature.
